content: Hello, I am Lattice Bank's digital assistant. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with Mx Alex Rowan?
Yes, this is Alex Rowan speaking.
First, I need to confirm your identity. What is your postcode?
What is your year of birth?

Thank you. I am calling about overdue payments on your account. Your credit card has 900.00 past due and is 4 days late. Your personal loan has 600.00 past due and is 4 days late. Your car loan has 450.00 past due and is 4 days late. Can you pay the full overdue amount for all of these today?
No, I won't be paying the card, not today and not on whatever date you offer next. The personal loan arrears were actually paid yesterday, and that car loan isn't mine.

Thank you. Please note that a payment can take up to two business days to post. I have noted that. Let us go through them one at a time. Could you pay 900.00 for the credit card on Thursday 15 October 2026?
No, I'm not paying the card on Thursday either. Like I said, I won't be paying it on any date you offer.
Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
